questions.question: Are the project requirements fully known and stable?
Do you expect requirements to change frequently as the project progresses?
Does this project involve high technical or operational risks?
Will users be closely and continuously involved throughout the development process?
Do you need to build a prototype early on to clarify requirements or test concepts?
Is formal and rigorous verification and validation (V&V) required at each phase?
Is there a very short timeline to deliver this project?
Can the system be easily broken down into independent modules or increments?
Is it critical to deliver a working version of the system early, even if it lacks full features?
Do you need frequent releases of new software updates for the users?
